declared: 2026-10-22, committed with the methods note before the scan's code and before any run on real data
drafted_by: a coding agent (Claude Code); the rule follows the acceptance list of #835 and the lead's brief

population.condition_labels: exact BugSigDB label of the experiment; no synonym merging; a multi-condition label is its own condition; a blank label is not a condition

eligibility.counted: distinct studies contributing at least one stool disease-vs-healthy comparison to the condition
eligibility.source: FIGURE_MIN_STUDIES in src/mtp/guild_maps.py and --min-studies in src/mtp/table1_trait_maps.py: the minimum studies behind a condition x body-site cell

traits.ranking: the Noel arm's directional screen (mtp.trait_screen) on the same core's count profiles; the ranking that originally chose cellulose is not recorded in the repository
traits.decreasing: tested, and more studies shift down than up
traits.order: p-value ascending, then more scored studies, then trait ID
traits.always_included_note: cellulose catabolic process joins the set, flagged, when it is not among the top N

statistics.set: matrix taxa bearing the trait that at least one stool decreased signature of the condition reports, at any rank
statistics.undefined_pairs: a pair whose union is empty has no distance; the mean is over the pairs that have one; a triple whose three sets are all empty is not tested

null.model: U6, cellulose_decr's whole-study-signature null (u6_units and signature_null's draws)
null.pool: every study in the population with a stool decreased signature, in any condition
null.p_value: (1 + draws at least as extreme) / (1 + draws)
null.shared_draws: one sequence of U6 draws serves every triple and trait; each eligible condition takes its own block of each draw's studies; a triple whose blocks would overlap gets its own U6 draws

ranking_of_triples: U6 p ascending over tested triples; ties reported as a range of ranks with the share of triples at most as large
multiplicity: none; every p-value is nominal, and selection-aware inference belongs to the unified multiple-testing layer

amendments.change: Pin the strain-rollup scope of the core run. Primary: off. Declared sensitivity: phenotype. A core of any other scope is refused, and a core that records no strain_rollup parameter (built before #828) is read as off. The summary, the provenance and --plan report the scope and its role.
amendments.reason: Review of PR #861 (#872). After #828 the default core is phenotype, and choosing between off and phenotype after seeing both would reopen the forking path this scan exists to close. off is the annotation the leads were chosen from, and the scope of the talk's numbers.
amendments.known_when_amended: No scan result on real data. Known: the counts on the pinned export (34 eligible conditions, 5,984 triples, a 355-study pool, 257 eligible units) and timings on synthetic fixtures.

amendments.change: Add a secondary rank of triples by U6 z beside the p rank, over the same two reference sets, with ties as a range. z ranks the mean pairwise distance ascending and the core descending, so more overlap comes first. A triple whose null has no spread has no z and no z rank. The trait table also ranks the traits by the share of triples whose z is at least as extreme as the lead's.
amendments.reason: Review of PR #861 (#872). PD is the largest condition, so its triples have tighter nulls and smaller p for the same excess overlap. A z rank separates large from unusual.
amendments.known_when_amended: As for the first amendment: no scan result on real data.
